messages:
oscar: OT game! Who's bringing snacks? I call dibs on the popcorn maker. :popcorn:

mei: I'll bring a 2-liter and napkins. Also: shoutout to whoever keeps moving my fantasy bench without asking. :joy:

oscar: @mei that was prob me last week, sorry. I panicked at a rain delay and switched for a kicker. regret immediately.

commish-bot: Reminder: lineup locks at 18:59 Sunday. No edits after.

nora: Real talk: does anyone have a plug for a streaming waiver? I need a D/ST with a favorable matchup.

devon: I can spare SEA DST for one game if you promise to return with snacks next week. :wink:

nora: Tempting. I'm offering my flex (bench) slot and a small bag of M&Ms.

devon: Deal. Send trade. Also quick poll: halftime chili taste test — mild, medium, or apocalypse? React with :hotsauce: for medium, :fire: for apocalypse, :leafy_green: for mild.

oscar: :fire: I'm not subtle.

mei: :hotsauce: living dangerously but not that dangerous.

commish-bot: Trade submitted: nora -> devon : Bench-Flex for SEA DST. Status: PENDING (auto-approve window).

nora: Accepted, fingers crossed the bot does the thing. If not, i'll bribe with extra napkins.

commish-bot: Trade executed at 1749991158. Note: please confirm your starting lineup.
devon: Confirmed. Also, whoever wins the halftime chili contest owes the losers bragging rights AND a GIF post in #general.

oscar: I will win and spam the hell out of #general with dumb cat GIFs.

mei: Can't wait. See you all at 6:30pm. PS — who wants a slice of my victory-stew? :bowl_with_spoon:
